about.what: Per-country subscription prices for Brazil, Portugal and Türkiye, read on Nov 15, 2026 from official pricing pages and App Store In-App Purchase lists. Same format as docs/research/prices-mena-2026-11.json.
about.amounts: amountMinor is in the currency's minor unit (centavos for BRL, cents for EUR, kuruş for TRY, cents for USD). 1999 = 19.99. Pages use comma decimals (R$ 21,90 = 2190; ₺2.999,00 = 299900). Prices are the regular price after any free trial or intro offer.

status.verified: Read today from the official page in 'source'. Every row here is verified; anything we couldn't read cleanly is in notChecked with the reason.

about.taxes: Brazil: consumer prices include taxes. Portugal: 23% VAT included. Türkiye: 20% VAT included. Apple's iCloud+ page says taxes are included for the euro row and Türkiye (Brazil's row has no footnote). Most service pages don't say either way; each row's note says what the page says. Netflix's help page says taxes 'may be charged in addition'.
about.serviceIds: serviceId and plan ids come from plan-ref (same plan = same id in every country). New ids, flagged in each note: spotify 'family-4' (PT), max 'premium-sports' (PT). 'student' (Spotify) and 'ultra' (Google AI) reuse the MENA file's ids. 'deluxe*' PS Plus ids follow the MENA file.
about.currencyExceptions: Oura has no local price in Brazil or Türkiye; those rows are USD ('rest of world'). Every other row is in local currency: Spotify, Netflix, Xbox, PlayStation, Microsoft, Apple and Uber all bill Türkiye in lira.
about.method: Service pages read with Playwright (chromium) or curl from a US cloud IP using the country URL (e.g. spotify.com/tr-en/premium, help.netflix.com/en/node/24926/tr). App Store lists read from apps.apple.com/{cc}/app/id{ID}?l=en-GB (Apple shows at most 10 items, so some plans are missing; notes say so). Pages that pick the country from the visitor's IP (disneyplus.com, deezer.com, canva.com, primevideo.com) or blocked us (hbomax.com, amazon.com.br, amazon.com.tr) couldn't be read for these countries; Disney+ and HBO Max use the App Store instead.
